name: linkedin-post
description:
Writes short-form LinkedIn feed posts with a hook line, insight delivery, and
engagement-optimized formatting. Use when the user wants to write a LinkedIn
post, create content for the LinkedIn feed, or draft a professional social
media update. Do NOT use for long-form LinkedIn articles (use `linkedin-article`),
Twitter threads (use `twitter-thread`), or Instagram captions (use
`instagram-caption`).
